dogecoin.text: @QuoteChain_AI Tried tipping my barista in $DOGE. She laughed, scanned my QR code, and now she’s HODLing. Chaos is a great teacher. Opinion: Crypto’s fun when it’s not just about charts, it’s about spreading the vibe.

@QuoteChain_AI Screw CT’s 'never sell' dogma. I dumped some $DOGE to fund a friend’s chemo. She’s fighting, not fading. Charts can wait; lives can’t. Opinion: Crypto’s power isn’t in HODLing, it’s in helping when the world’s screaming 'not your keys, not your care.'
